verdict.rationale: Jina Reader offers a headless Chrome engine (x-engine: browser) and a hosted proxy pool that 'rotates residential/datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically', which addresses part of the anti-bot theme, but there is no evidence of a specifically 'undetected' or stealth browser fingerprint-evasion mode (e.g., patched headless detection signatures). Missing for 10: explicit undetected/stealth browser fingerprinting evasion, evidence of bypassing sophisticated bot-detection systems (e.g., Cloudflare, DataDome) beyond generic proxy rotation, and independent confirmation of anti-bot effectiveness.
